problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the municipal budget across 18 different infrastructure projects to maximize overall community benefit.  
The features of each project are listed below:  
* Project A: benefit score is 0.167, impact factor is 0.048, allocation limits [0.024, 0.712]  
* Project B: benefit score is 0.144, impact factor is 0.233, allocation limits [0.054, 0.729]  
* Project C: benefit score is 0.054, impact factor is 0.088, allocation limits [0.027, 0.841]  
* Project D: benefit score is 0.046, impact factor is 0.282, allocation limits [0.054, 0.595]  
* Project E: benefit score is 0.097, impact factor is 0.184, allocation limits [0.002, 0.894]  
* Project F: benefit score is 0.102, impact factor is 0.240, allocation limits [0.004, 0.435]  
* Project G: benefit score is 0.136, impact factor is 0.013, allocation limits [0.054, 0.874]  
* Project H: benefit score is 0.092, impact factor is 0.240, allocation limits [0.010, 0.469]  
* Project I: benefit score is 0.150, impact factor is 0.167, allocation limits [0.089, 0.346]  
* Project J: benefit score is 0.045, impact factor is 0.247, allocation limits [0.042, 0.500]  
* Project K: benefit score is 0.155, impact factor is 0.257, allocation limits [0.000, 0.516]  
* Project L: benefit score is 0.022, impact factor is 0.035, allocation limits [0.022, 0.855]  
* Project M: benefit score is 0.038, impact factor is 0.050, allocation limits [0.023, 0.351]  
* Project N: benefit score is 0.089, impact factor is 0.230, allocation limits [0.039, 0.326]  
* Project O: benefit score is 0.040, impact factor is 0.269, allocation limits [0.035, 0.391]  
* Project P: benefit score is 0.022, impact factor is 0.246, allocation limits [0.029, 0.557]  
* Project Q: benefit score is 0.169, impact factor is 0.099, allocation limits [0.092, 0.501]  
* Project R: benefit score is 0.188, impact factor is 0.149, allocation limits [0.068, 0.409]  

Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified allocation range, and all fractions must add up to one. To ensure timely completion, the set of high-priority projects, denoted by L = {B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, O, P, Q, R}, must together receive at least 0.518 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.252, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.080.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
